jobs.title: Head of Analytics
jobs.description: The Head of Analytics enables the access to qualitative information via the planning, building and running of conceptual “single point of truth” and the delivery of Analytics products to enable fact-based decision making and to optimize any process within MET. Essential responsibilities Maintain the Analytics Operating Model detailing governance, process, data and IT Architecture principles of MET Group Analytics. Supervise and support Analytics IT Applications; Azure Databricks, MS Power BI, Confluent ad internally developed IT Applications (built with Databricks) Create and maintain the information and analytics products architecture to support the delivery of all analytics products  Develop and maintain data integration from internal and external data sources to supply all analytics products with qualitative and actualized information Provision data & information to operational applications requiring additional data sources (eg. Endur, CCH Tagetik, …,) Enable data discovery (via providing queries/views but also training and best practices) for advanced users (quant analysts, FP&A analysts, controllers, risk managers, …) Deliver and maintain standard reports and dashboards Develop and maintain the Analytics products architecture Provide and promote best practices regarding information visualization (e.g. IBCS) and define and maintain the MET Reporting Governance Supervise the IT Application landscape delivering Analytics IT Capabilities

jobs.title: Sales Optimisation Advisor
jobs.description: As we continue to evolve our client portfolio and expand, MET Energia Italia is now looking for a talented Sales Optimisation Advisor, who will be contributing to the growth of the company in the Italian market. You will play a key role in developing and managing initiatives aimed at maximizing the value of customers acquired by MET Energia Italia within the Household segment, across both digital and agent-based sales channels. In this role, you will contribute to our daily operations through: Define the key requirements and overall strategy to establish a strong and valuable relationship with customers following the successful completion of the sales process (from welcome communications to cross-selling and broader customer monetization initiatives) and manage related development projects to ensure effective and timely execution Oversee daily operations aimed at enhancing customer value, reducing churn, and increasing long-term revenues, ensuring full alignment with SME and Household Sales, Operations, and Back-Office teams Develop and implement an analytical framework to support data-driven decision-making and identify the most effective strategies to maximize customer value Support the CEO, CFO, Head of SME & B2C, and Head of B2C of MET Energia Italia in shaping the Digital Sales strategy within the broader company strategy, contributing to the definition of short- and long-term targets and ensuring the availability of necessary resources Be active and ready to take on new challenges in other areas of MET should this become your desire

jobs.title: Renewables Project Manager
jobs.description: The objective of the role is to drive and support the development and technical deliverables of MET Group’s Renewable and Asset Segment’s – with primary focus on Italy however with opportunity to assist on the Segment’s other projects in Western Europe - solar (photovoltaic) projects, provide coordination from project development, construction to the operation & maintenance of the assets. End-to-end project management, with full accountability for construction budget, schedule, quality and successful delivery of the company’s Italian renewable energy projects, driving planning, procurement, construction and commissioning activities; Leading tendering processes and negotiating, awarding and managing contracts related to the construction of the company’s renewable energy projects, while coordinating all contractors, suppliers, public authorities and service providers throughout the project lifecycle; Evaluating and supporting the technical side of renewable energy projects’ business development activities; Supporting the commercial and technical optimisation of renewable energy projects during construction and operational phases; Analysing, evaluating and preparing the company’s business development projects for contracting and execution; Preparing and analysing technical studies, assessments and evaluations related to the renewable energy industry; Acting as the primary interface with partners, contractors, subcontractors, public authorities, permitting bodies, TSO/DSO and other key stakeholders, ensuring effective coordination and timely resolution of project-related matters; Monitoring project progress against budget and schedule, identifying risks and implementing mitigation measures to ensure on-time and on-budget delivery; Supporting and coordinating internal approval processes related to projects, investments and transactions; Asset Management/ O&M tendering, contract negotiation and management; Performance, KPI, energy production and revenue monitoring and tracking; Performing any other duties and responsibilities required for the successful development, construction and operation of the company’s renewable energy projects.

jobs.title: Head of Trade Compliance: Energy & Financial Commodities and Derivatives (REMIT / EMIR / MAR / MiFID II/ FINFRAG)
jobs.description: Role summary: The Senior Trade Compliance Officer is responsible for designing, operating and continuously enhancing the compliance framework for physical and financial energy and commodities trading activities, with particular focus on REMIT, EMIR, MAR and MiFID II obligations across EU, UK and (where applicable) Swiss markets. The role acts as a senior advisor to trading, risk, legal and middle-office, providing real‑time guidance on market conduct, reporting, disclosure, and surveillance matters. Key responsibilities Act as the primary day‑to‑day  compliance  contact for trading desks across physical and financial commodities (e.g. power, gas, emissions, oil, certificates, derivatives). Provide timely, pragmatic advice on trade compliance questions, including REMIT inside information and disclosure, MAR market abuse risk, EMIR and MiFID II transaction and trade reporting, and conduct requirements. Design, operate and continuously improve the trade compliance framework, including policies, procedures, controls and governance for energy and commodities trading businesses. Lead or oversee trade surveillance across relevant asset classes (power, gas, emissions, oil and commodity derivatives), including calibration and optimisation of surveillance tools and alert scenarios for MAR and REMIT risks. Monitor, investigate and document alerts and potential breaches relating to insider trading, market manipulation, capacity hoarding, spoofing, layering and other abusive practices under MAR and REMIT. Oversee regulatory reporting, notifications and disclosures under REMIT, EMIR, MiFID II/MiFIR and other applicable regimes (e.g. inside information disclosures, ACER/ENTSOs reporting, EMIR trade reporting, MiFID II transaction reporting). Coordinate responses to inquiries, audits and investigations from regulators, exchanges, TSOs, and other competent authorities relating to trading activities and market conduct. Support the regulatory impact assessment and implementation of new or amended requirements (e.g. REMIT II implementing acts, EMIR refit, MAR/MiFID II updates), translating them into business‑ready processes and controls. Provide compliance input into new products, trading strategies, market entries and business initiatives, ensuring regulatory obligations are identified and addressed at an early stage. Develop and deliver targeted training for front office, operations, risk and support functions on REMIT, EMIR, MAR, MiFID II and broader trade compliance topics. Maintain and update internal policy documents, guidance notes and desk procedures related to market conduct, reporting, surveillance, conflicts of interest, and use of inside information. Conduct periodic compliance risk assessments of trading activities, identify key regulatory and conduct risks, and define remediation actions and monitoring plans. Track regulatory and market design developments across relevant jurisdictions and advise senior management on emerging compliance risks and strategic implications. Represent the company in relevant industry forums, working groups and external engagements with regulators or system operators on trade compliance and market design topics.

jobs.title: Gas Dispatcher
jobs.description: Core tasks of the team include nomination activities, asset optimization, capacity booking and position balancing on a 24/7 basis The 'Shift Rota' will encompass morning, afternoon and night shifts, running Monday through Sunday Responsible for energy position management Nominations of flows and virtual points Transport capacity booking Checking about pipeline maintenance and availability

jobs.title: Treasury Specialist
jobs.description: As we continue to evolve our client portfolio and expand, MET Energia Italia is now looking for a talented Treasury Specialist to join the Finance team, reporting to the AFC Manager. The role will contribute to supporting and strengthening the company’s development in the Italian market. You will be responsible for managing payment and collection processes, monitoring cash flow, and preparing medium to long‑term financial forecasts. Skilled in maintaining strong, productive relationships with banking partners. Experienced at managing credit facilities, loans, and debt instruments to optimize the company’s financial structure and ensure liquidity. Step by step you will take on several activities that are part of the main duties within the Portfolio team, bringing your invaluable contribution to our daily operations: Payments Management: Verify and prepare daily payment batches to ensure timely and accurate disbursements Collections: Oversee and process direct debit transactions for customer payments, ensuring proper authorization and execution Cash Flow Planning & Reporting : Monitor cash flow trends and develop medium- and long‑term financial forecasts and reports Banking Relationship Management: Support the maintenance of relationships with financial institutions and assist in negotiating banking terms and conditions Debt Optimization: Contribute to the management of loans, credit facilities, and other financing instruments to optimize the company’s debt structure Supporting the launch of new ideas and projects to grow the business Be active and ready to take on new challenges in other areas of MET should this become your desire

jobs.title: Senior Market Risk Analyst - Western Europe
jobs.description: Act as Deputy to the Market Risk Manager for the Western European Sales Division based in the HQ in Switzerland. Engage daily with regional subsidiaries, including operations and portfolio managers, sales teams, CFOs, and the Division Head, to assess the risks linked to sales activities and other operations. Collaborate with senior leadership to integrate risk considerations into daily decision-making and long-term strategy. Support the implementation of the Group’s risk framework and policies across local subsidiaries, ensuring alignment with Group standards. Monitor positions, oversee sales activities, track PnL, and analyze risk data to identify exposures and mitigate risks. Report deviations, incidents, or relevant risk issues at both Divisional and local levels to the Market Risk Manager. Contribute to the development of tailored frameworks that address the specific risk drivers of local businesses. Support Group Market Risk in enhancing risk models, analytics, and reporting tools to optimize monitoring. Conduct advanced risk assessments, including VaR back-testing, sensitivity analyses, and scenario simulations. Participate in model validation processes and ensure compliance with regulatory and internal governance requirements. Design innovative, actionable solutions to address complex market risk challenges in collaboration with commercial and risk stakeholders. Help shape Divisional risk policies and procedures in close partnership with senior leaders and the Market Risk Manager

jobs.title: Data Analytics & Integrations Specialist
jobs.description: As we continue to evolve our client portfolio and expand, MET Energia Italia is now looking for a talented Data Analytics & Integrations Specialist , who will contribute to the company's growth and support its digital transformation journey. As Data Analytics Specialist , you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data management and business intelligence solutions that support business operations and decision-making. Working closely with internal stakeholders and the MET Group Analytics team, you will translate business needs into scalable technical solutions, develops data models and reporting tools, and contribute to the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and data-driven capabilities across the organization. As Integrations Specialist , you will be responsible for gathering and tracking functional requirements, developing and maintaining operational automations built in Azure Databricks, and managing integrations between business applications, data platforms, and Databricks. You will ensure seamless data flows, support process automation initiatives, and contribute to the reliability and efficiency of the company's technology ecosystem. As part of the IT team, you will progressively take ownership of a variety of activities, making a valuable contribution to our daily operations through the following responsibilities: Collaborate with Met Group Analytics team on BI activities, design, functional analysis, upgrading and maintenance Define user requirements and translating them into technical specifications documents and develop solutions with existing or new tools Improve existing systems and take care of the implementation process of new applications designed and chosen to maximize the productivity of the company and its activities Data Modelling and database development tools PL/SQL (mainly Oracle and MS SQL Server) Develop and maintain SQL and Python scripts to support data analytics, system integrations, and process automation Communicate and transform information into effective visual presentations (data visualization, presentation skills, incl. mastery of Power Point) Supporting the launch of new ideas and projects to grow the business Be active and ready to take on new challenges in other areas of MET should this become your desire

jobs.title: Area Manager
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 


Ambasciatori

In Octopus vogliamo rendere l’energia rinnovabile accessibile a tutti, non solo a chi ci scopre sul sito. Per questo gli Ambasciatori hanno un ruolo fondamentale: portano Octopus dove ancora non siamo arrivati, incontrano le persone dal vivo, ascoltano i loro bisogni e spiegano in modo semplice cosa rende diverso il nostro modo di fare energia.

Per molte persone, Octopus inizierà proprio da quella conversazione: da come saprai creare fiducia, spiegare le nostre offerte con chiarezza e far vivere il nostro modo di essere, umano, concreto e senza complicazioni inutili.

jobs.title: Business Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We’re making electric vehicle charging as smart and as simple as possible by building the giant, virtual charging platform of the future.
In just four years, Octopus Electroverse has grown to become one of the largest eMobility players globally, with over 1.4 million connected electric vehicle chargers and a customer ecosystem spanning web, iOS, Android, CarPlay, Android Auto & Automotive OS, and more. 
But it’s just the start: we’re busy expanding internationally, working with more automotive and tech partners, building exciting new features at scale, and creating the integrated charging experiences of the future - all in the name of making public EV charging super simple for customers.
Octopus Fleet is our business offering, a multifunctional team made up of product, development, commercial, operations, marketing, partnerships and more - all focused on simplifying operations across mixed and fully electrified vehicle fleets.
About the Role
We are looking for a highly detail-oriented and enthusiastic Business Operations Specialist to join the Octopus Fleet team. In this pivotal new role, you will support new businesses joining Octopus Fleet, guiding them through a smooth, compliant onboarding process as they transition to sustainable EV energy.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with great communication skills and a passion for customer service to learn the operational ropes of a high-growth scale-up.

jobs.title: Capital Markets Analyst
jobs.description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing 

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.

We are a market-leading, mission-driven organisation focused on accelerating the transition to a net-zero economy through innovative financing solutions. As we enter a significant period of growth, we are scaling our Capital Markets team to support our increasingly sophisticated funding requirements.
 
 
This is a high-growth opportunity for an analytical professional looking to build a career in Capital Markets. 
Joining as an Analyst, you will gain hands-on exposure to complex debt facilities and see the full lifecycle of a securitisation facility. You won't just be processing data; you will be learning how to structure and manage the capital which fuels a rapidly expanding leasing business.

jobs.title: Customer Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. 
Octopus Energy started with a bold idea: to build Britain’s first truly digital energy supplier. By combining world-class tech with brilliant humans who care deeply about customers and driving the renewable energy transition, we made it happen and in 2025, we became Britain’s largest energy supplier. 
Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.
And we constantly push to make energy better. Tirelessly campaigning for fair protections for customers. And building innovative technologies that forge a path to a green energy system.
We’re made up of 10,000+ authentic, committed people working around the world on stuff you'd never expect. We're united by a shared goal: to drive the global green energy revolution. Read our Spotlight series to meet some of the team.
About Octopus Electroverse
We’re making electric vehicle ownership as smart and as simple as possible by building the giant, virtual charging platform of the future.
In just four years, Octopus Electroverse has grown to become one of the largest eMobility players globally, with over 1 million connected electric vehicle chargers and a customer ecosystem spanning web, iOS, Android, CarPlay, Android Auto & Automotive OS, and more. 
But it’s just the start: we’re busy expanding internationally, working with more automotive and tech partners, building exciting new features at scale, and creating the integrated charging experiences of the future - all in the name of making public EV charging super simple for customers.
Electroverse is a multifunctional team made up of product, development, commercial, operations, marketing, partnerships and more - all focused together on making Octopus the go-to name in EV charging. 
About the role
We’re looking for a Customer Specialist to join our operations team and delight our customers as we grow Electroverse. You’ll speak to our customers over email and online chat and get stuck in with operational processes. 
This role is based in the London office, with the option to work from home 2 days a week, with the standard of 9am - 5.30pm Monday to Friday.

jobs.title: Energy Support Social Worker
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a passionate, empathetic and experienced Social Worker to join our team to help support both customers and colleagues. The role is primarily office based in order to ensure support to our customers and team members is available when needed.

jobs.title: Non trovi posizioni aperte in linea con il tuo profilo?
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa, pulita e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 


Aiutaci a portare la rivoluzione Octopus in Italia!
 
 
Inviaci il tuo CV e dicci qualcosa su di te..

jobs.title: Senior TechOps Generalist
jobs.location: London (GB) | Manchester (GB) | Brighton (GB) | Coventry (GB) | Leicester (GB) | Warwick (GB)
jobs.description:
Seen this advert before? That is because we are continuing to grow!
 
We are very excited to be growing our small and efficient TechOps team at Octopus. We aren't looking for standard IT support - we are looking for an ambitious, deeply knowledgeable and experienced TechOps Generalist to join our team, to grow with the rest of the company, and ensure we are doing so in a secure and safe way.
You will be a key partner in defining what TechOps is at Octopus. We will be continuing to shape this team to provide world class support to our employees, building our way out of problems with engineering firepower and undertaking transformational organisational change. We don't just "fix" things - we automate them out of existence.
For us, a Generalist isn’t about knowing a little of everything, it’s a multi-disciplinary role for someone who’s deeply experienced in many facets of Enterprise IT. Think multi-domain specialist - not Jack of all trades.

What is TechOps?
A more modern, more lean version of a traditional Enterprise IT team with around one of us for every 1000 people at Octopus. We cover everything from what most people would call “1st line support” all the way up to high-level strategic planning, and everything in between.
We tackle big problems and the breadth of work is huge. Dealing with ambiguity is a key part of working in TechOps, and every day will be a new and exciting one, working on varying challenges across the company and keeping plates spinning.
We have a cloud-first approach to everything we do. This allows us to scale quickly and focus on things where we can add the most value. No on-prem AD here!
 
Roles that you might currently be in: Systems engineer, DevOps, Tech support, Technical support, Technical support analyst, IT support, IT desktop support, Systems Administrator, Network Administrator, Workplace technology, Solutions specialist, Solutions administrator, Systems manager, Support manager.

jobs.title: Systems Integrator
jobs.description: Help us make a big green dent in the universe. We're on a mission to drive the global renewable energy revolution, and we need many more people to help us make our vision a reality. Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. As we continue to expand our investment base, we are dedicated to building a diverse team that reflects the communities we serve. Currently, we manage a global portfolio of over £8 billion in renewable energy assets. We are committed to delivering best-in-class responsible investment activity, offering like-minded investors the means and products to invest their capital sustainably. It is our ambition to change the entire energy lifecycle and make every green electron matter, delivering the best outcomes for customers, investors, the environment and society, accelerating the transition to net zero. OEGEN Data, Tech & Transformation Team We are embarking on a comprehensive transformation program designed to drive significant advancements in our business operations and technology landscape. Our primary goal is to transition from our current reliance on legacy systems and specialized off-the-shelf tools to a more integrated, AI-driven, and data-centric operational model. Leveraging insights and guidance from our other technically mature entities like Kraken and OE, we plan to adopt cutting-edge tools and capabilities, particularly in AI and Python-driven solutions. By investing in a diverse range of skills, we aim to create a hybrid team capable of operating in both our legacy and future environments, ultimately transforming OEGEN into an efficient, data-driven organization. About the role The tools are already here. Like the rest of OE Group, OEGEN runs on Databricks, we're moving onto our own Microsoft 365 tenant, and Octopus Energy Group gives us access to a powerful set of shared data and AI capabilities. What we're missing is someone whose job is to make all of it work together for our Fund Management business - and then build genuinely useful things on top of it. This is a two-sided role. On one side, you'll integrate: wiring third-party systems, internal apps and document storage into the environment we already have, setting sensible guardrails around access and cost, and adopting existing Group capability wherever it does the job rather than rebuilding it. On the other, you'll build: turning those connections into data products, internal tools and AI-enabled workflows that fund management, asset management and finance use every day. Tying the two together, you'll develop and own the playbook - the documented, repeatable patterns for how a new system gets connected, how a tool gets built and shipped, and how both get supported afterwards - so that what you learn once becomes how the whole team works. The two halves feed each other: you'll understand what's possible because you built the plumbing, and you'll build better plumbing because you know what people actually do with it. We want someone with genuine ideas about where AI can take a business like ours, and the pragmatism to ship them. Our team has already built an Excel data mart plugin that puts gold-layer tables directly in the hands of non-technical staff, a metrics taxonomy app that keeps third-party definitions aligned with our own, and AI-assisted workflows that scaffold documentation automatically. There's a long list of things we haven't got to yet. Expect roughly half your time on integration and enablement and half on building, and expect to work closely with the central data platform team so what we do in OEGEN stays consistent with the wider estate and our specific needs get onto their roadmap.

jobs.title: We’re always on the lookout for brilliant humans
jobs.description:
At Octopus Energy, we don’t just do traditional job specs. We don’t love rigid job titles. And we don’t believe that great people only come along when you happen to have a “vacancy”.
 
We’re building something big - tech that transforms whole industries, teams that reimagine what brilliant looks like and products that people and customers actually love. That means our talent team are always open to meeting and speaking with exceptional humans who are passionate to help us do more of that.
 
Maybe you’ve run big teams and we don’t mean just managing FTEs - you’ll happily work with no direct reports, because your enthusiasm means awesome people will follow you, and you’ll get stuff done. Maybe you’ve shaped strategy, launched products, scaled operations or quietly turned chaos into clarity. Maybe you’ve done the big jobs but you’re still hungry to build something meaningful. You probably don’t need a manager to tell you what needs doing. You spot the gaps and get stuck in. We don’t work to backlogs, we don’t write business cases but we prioritise effectiveness and efficiency above all else. We expect accountability without process, and responsibility without functional shoulder pads. We get stuff done by knowing what’s right and sometimes that’s hard.
 
We don’t care what your last job title was. We care that you’ve got real experience a sharp instinct for what matters and a bit of fire in your belly to use it for something good.
 
There’s no neat box for this advert. You might be excited by operations, tech, customer, product, commercial, strategy or something else entirely. We’ve got a lot going on and the best people often help us figure out where they fit.
 
We’re a place where leaders still answer customer emails. Where we care more about effectiveness than process. Where job titles don’t matter as much as getting stuff done. Where accountability isn’t hidden behind decks or backlogs - it’s owned, lived, and felt. And where you can go from an idea to live in days, not months.
 
If this sounds like your kind of place and you’ve built or led things that mattered at scale - we’d love to hear from you. If you're not quite at a senior level in your career (think 10+ years under your belt) there is still a place you can register speculative interest here
 
Tell us what excites you and where you think you could make an impact. We’ll take it from there.

jobs.title: Women in Field Sales: Venue Sales Rep
jobs.location: United Kingdom | Southampton (GB) | London (GB) | Bristol (GB) | Glasgow (GB) | Milton Keynes (GB) | Leeds (GB) | Cardiff (GB) | Manchester (GB)
jobs.description:
Supporting women in field sales in the energy industry:

At Octopus Energy, we’re on a mission to make energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. To get there, we need brilliant people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives helping us change the industry.

Women account for 49% of full time employees in UK sales and customer focused jobs, yet they remain underrepresented in many commercial and field based roles. In field sales roles women only make up around 40% of roles in the UK and 29% in senior commercial roles, which is about 1 in 4 roles. We want to help change that by creating a field sales environment where women can build confidence, grow their careers and progress into leadership.

We’re looking for incredible women across the UK to join our team as Venue Sales Representatives. Forget traditional field sales! We’re reinventing customer interactions and showing people that talking about energy can be engaging, helpful and fun!

You’ll be one of the friendly faces of Octopus Energy, meeting customers in well known venues across the UK. You’ll start genuine conversations, explain what makes Octopus different and help people make energy choices that work for them and the planet.

You don't need to know everything about energy or sales. We’ll give you the training, support and tools you need to thrive. Previous sales experience would be a real advantage, but we’d also love to hear from people with strong customer focused experience and a natural ability to connect with others. This is not about tradtional sales or scripts. It’s about listening, connecting with people and bringing your personality to work
Who we are:
We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. Powering over 10 million homes in Britain and abroad with award winning customer service and innovative green energy offers, while building a more sustainable energy system for tomorrow. We empower our people to giveoutrageously good customer service, and fight to make energy fairer, more affordable, and more accessible for all. We are striving to halt the climate emergency by unlocking a smart, 100% green grid. We are using technology to transform the energy system; making electricity green and affordable, creatingone-of-a-kind energy innovations.
Our work is powered by freedom, autonomy and responsibility. We wonbest company to work for in 2022 on Glassdoor and were voted as one of the best places to work in 2026 from the Sunday Times. Our Group CEO, Greg, has recordeda podcast about our culture and how we empower our people - give it a listen to find out more about Octopus Energy!
